intro: You carried the platinum discs out to the Tanaris desert, and the Stone Watcher of Norgannon has appeared at the Uldum Pedestal. It guards entry to the Uldum compound and admits only those whose disc set includes the Plates of Uldum. You are to learn its story before going on.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: "Salutations - I am a guardian of entry. Unless you have the Plates of Uldum already integrated with your disc set, I will not allow for entry into the Uldum compound."

The appearance of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon must be the reaction that was hoped for in sending you out to the Tanaris desert with the platinum discs. As instructed, you will need to find out what the story behind the Stone Watcher is before continuing on.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The purpose of the stone watcher must be learned before continuing on...

clips.title: Completion
paras: The stone watcher's voice resonates with power and authority:
"Your discs will be returned to you once you access the pedestal. When you have obtained the Plates of Uldum and incorporated them into your existing disc set, you may then enter the complex."
